question.problem:
$6|10$ **and** $6|18,$ **or** $11$ is prime **and** odd.

Express the compound statement above in symbolic form given the following notations:

- $M:6|10$

- $P:6|18$

- $N:11\text{ is prime}$

- $Q:11\text{ is odd}$
question.worked_solution:
The word "and" is represented by the symbol "$∧$", while the word "or" is represented by the symbol "$∨$".

Note that this sentence consists of two parts:

- **Part 1:** $6|10$ and $6|18.$ This corresponds to

$$
{{6|10}_{⏟}}_{M}\,{{\text{and}}_{⏟}}_{∧}\,{{6|18}_{⏟}}_{P}
$$

that is, $M∧P.$

- **Part 2:** $11$ is prime and odd. This corresponds to

$$
{{11\text{ is prime}}_{⏟}}_{N}\,{{\text{and}}_{⏟}}_{∧}\,{{11\text{ is odd }}_{⏟}}_{Q},
$$

that is, $N∧Q.$

So, we can express the sentence as

$$
{{6|10\text{ and }6|18}_{⏟}}_{M\,∧\,P}\,{{\text{or}}_{⏟}}_{∨}\,{{11\text{ is prime }\text{and}\text{ odd }}_{⏟}}_{N\,∧\,Q},
$$

that is, $(M∧P)∨(N∧Q).$
